text: Azores Airlines is an airline of the SATA group: the European Commission lists it among the group's operating subsidiaries controlled by the group's holding company, and the group's own site runs the sale of 'SATA Internacional – Azores Airlines' under SATA Holding.
short: Azores Airlines is an operating subsidiary of the SATA group (SATA Holding)

source.name: European Commission press release: State aid: Commission approves €453.25 million Portuguese restructuring aid in favour of SATA Group (IP/22/3525)
source.quote: with a holding company replacing SATA Air Açores in controlling its operating subsidiaries (SATA Air Açores, Azores Airlines and SGA)

additionalSources.name: Azores Airlines: SATA Holding recebe oito manifestações de interesse
additionalSources.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. English: 'SATA Holding has received eight expressions of interest for the privatisation of SATA Internacional – Azores Airlines.'
additionalSources.quote: A SATA Holding recebeu oito manifestações de interesse para o processo de privatização da SATA Internacional – Azores Airlines
